_comment: Pre-migration state with python-expert.md at the v0 path. Migration 001 moves it under domain-experts/, then migration 002 deletes domain-experts/ entirely. Migration 003 (roadmap shutdown) finds nothing to act on in this before/ tree — it has no roadmap wrapper under .claude/commands/awos/ — so it skips. Final state: the old path is empty, the migrated subdirectory is gone. The migration-version file's exact numeric content is asserted dynamically by tests/installer/migration-runner.test.js (it reflects the highest migration version processed, not just the ones whose preconditions matched this tree) — only its existence is pinned here.
